# AgendaBurn

> Free real-time meeting cost calculator. Add attendees by salary and role, start the timer, and watch the dollar cost of the meeting tick up live.

AgendaBurn, formerly MeetingMeter, is the product at https://agendaburn.com. The legacy domain meetingmeter.tech redirects here. Articles live on the blog at https://blog.agendaburn.com/.

## Product

- [AgendaBurn home](https://agendaburn.com/): Product overview, pricing, and FAQ
- [Meeting cost calculator](https://agendaburn.com/app): The calculator. Add attendees, start the timer, and see the live cost
- [How much does a meeting cost?](https://agendaburn.com/blog/how-much-does-a-meeting-cost): 2026 figures for what a meeting costs and how the calculator works
- [Privacy policy](https://agendaburn.com/privacy): What AgendaBurn stores and which processors it uses
- [Terms of service](https://agendaburn.com/terms): Rules for the free calculator and Pro plans

## Blog

- [AgendaBurn Blog](https://blog.agendaburn.com/): All articles
- [$37 Billion Wasted on Meetings](https://blog.agendaburn.com/37-billion-wasted-on-meetings-is-your-company-guilty/): The $37 billion estimate and how to tell if a company is part of it
- [Async-First Manifesto](https://blog.agendaburn.com/async-first-manifesto-replace-71-of-meetings-with-docs/): Replace most meetings with written updates
- [How Much Does a Meeting Cost Your Company?](https://blog.agendaburn.com/how-much-does-a-meeting-cost-your-company/): The hourly math for a team meeting
- [Meeting Cost Calculator: How Much Is Your Stand-Up?](https://blog.agendaburn.com/meeting-cost-calculator-how-much-is-your-stand-up/): What a recurring stand-up costs
- [Why Most Meetings Are Useless](https://blog.agendaburn.com/why-most-meetings-are-useless-and-cost-you-millions/): Why status meetings fail and what to do instead
